description: Tie a draft to its topic, with the language it is written in. Do this for every draft you create, so the ledger knows what was written and posted.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: A topic id from topics_add or topics_list.

language.description: The language the draft is written in.

name: topics_link
title: Tie drafts to a topic
